reviews.title: Close AS2 Area 7 NetStream attachAudio, attachVideo, publish, and liveDelay gaps
reviews.summary: Implements AS2 NetStream.prototype.attachAudio, attachVideo, publish, and liveDelay across Rust ScriptAS2Stream, web/video.js, and actionscript/intrinsics.js with an in-memory live loopback stream registry, duplicate BadName protection, UnpublishNotify subscriber dispatch, and live subscriber metadata/send/Camera delivery.

entries.note: Attaches a Microphone source or false/null detach on NetStream instances via Rust ScriptAS2Stream and web/video.js live loopback publishing.
Attaches a Camera source (with optional snapshotMilliseconds) or false/null detach on NetStream instances and delivers frames to live loopback Video subscribers.
Read-only numeric liveDelay property on NetStream reporting buffered live-stream delay in seconds from ScriptAS2Stream.

Publishes and unpublishes named live/record/append streams in the browser loopback registry, dispatching NetStream.Publish.Start, NetStream.Publish.BadName on active name collisions, and NetStream.Unpublish.Success / NetStream.Play.UnpublishNotify.
